preserved_v1_contract.objective: Acquire three ECG-triggered cardiac inversion-prepared Cartesian bSSFP images with TI 100, 400 and 1200 ms measured from the inversion-pulse center to each image's central-k-space echo. Acquire all source images at the same cardiac phase and retain their preparation metadata; an inversion may occur in a preceding heartbeat. Allow at least three RR intervals of recovery between separate inversion preparations. Every acquired ADC sample must lie between 600 and 800 ms after its ECG R-wave trigger, using nominal RR 1000 ms on physio1; preparations may precede that window. Use ordinary Cartesian reconstruction. Complete magnetization preparation before the imaging window. Balance net gradient area on all three axes in every readout TR; alternate excitation RF phase by 180 degrees between readout TRs and keep receiver phases coherent with that RF phase cycle. Use symmetric echo timing in every acquired readout TR: TE is measured from the excitation RF center to the readout k-space-center echo, and abs(TE - TR/2) must be no more than max(0.01 ms, 0.05 times TR). Each prepared frame must have exactly one inversion RF event before the bSSFP readout train, with a waveform-derived nominal flip of at least 170 degrees. Inversion timing is measured between RF center and central-k-space echo; the timing tolerance is twice the larger of the RF and block-duration rasters.
